 Callum Turner is spending the day with his mom.
 The 36-year-old One Night Only actor held on tight to his dog as he and his mom Rosemary Turner stopped by a coffee shop to grab some coffees to go on Wednesday afternoon (November 4) in New York City.
 For his outing, Callum sported a brown leather jacket over a white button-down shirt paired with jeans and brown sneakers.
 4 
 If you didn’t see the news, it was recently reported that Callum is one of at least four British actors that was offered a screen test while Amazon MGM Studios looks to cast the next James Bond ! 
 The next Bond movie will be directed by Denis Villeneuve , known for his work on Dune , with a screenplay from Peaky Blinders creator Steven Knight .
 4 
 There is also no confirmed release date for the upcoming film.
 Find out the recent betting odds for who will be the next 007. 
 If you didn’t see, past Bond star Pierce Brosnan shared his thoughts on who could possibly take over the iconic role.
